messages:
mia-sales: Quick heads-up from Acme — they want a performance verification run on Dedicated: 20–30 min steady + short stress spike. Also asked about burst billing and logs retention.
raj-se: Got it. Need exact traffic mix and model selection. Will confirm sequence length distribution, model variant (which repo tag), and whether they want prompt retention.
mia-sales: Their note: steady 30m at 150 rps, then a 5m spike to 950 rps. Token mix: 40% ~32t, 40% ~128t, 20% ~384t. Model preference: r-instruct-2b. They will be on a reserved slot but want to ensure bursts work.
tom-ae: On pricing: they want to know if burst beyond reserved capacity behaves like on-demand or if we cap it during POC. Finance wants a standard POC clause.
raj-se: For r-instruct-2b we should warm KV cache and ramp slowly. Recommend 7m ramp and set batching parameters: batching=auto, max_batch_tokens=4096. Also enforce per-request timeout.
anne-eng-sre: Proposed schedule for perf run:
```
- 00:00-07:00 ramp 0 -> 150 rps (cache warm)
- 07:00-37:00 steady 150 rps
- 37:00-42:00 ramp to 950 rps
- 42:00-47:00 hold 950 rps
- 47:00-50:00 cool down
metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency (ms), errors, GPU util, tokens/sec
```
mia-sales: Olivia — can you confirm the CIDRs we'll use for the test and whether prompt content must be redacted in logs?
olivia-prospect: CIDR yes, will DM. Prompts: must not be stored in plain text logs. We can accept hashed or redacted samples for debugging. Also want an estimated cost for the spike.
security-bot: Compliance note: we can enable prompt redaction at rest and enforce customer-managed KMS for encryption. SOC2 artifacts available on request.
tom-ae: We'll draft a POC addendum: burst allowed up to X minutes per hour during POC; beyond that charged at on-demand rate. @sara-legal can you review the clause?
sara-legal: I'll review and propose wording; aiming for minimal friction for sales.
raj-se: Cost estimate (very rough): assume avg 180 tokens per request. Spike 5m at 950 rps => ~51.3M tokens. Multiply by current on-demand unit to get ballpark. Finance to add numbers.
anne-eng-sre: If Acme requires no fallback to hosted endpoints, we'll set failover=false. That increases risk of failed requests under saturation. We'll need to add headroom to reserved capacity; I'll recommend instance counts in the final run report.
mia-sales: Oliva, is full no-failover acceptable?
olivia-prospect: We prefer no external routing for security reasons. If the pool can't handle it, we'd rather see errors than have traffic exit the dedicated boundary.
raj-se: Understood. We'll plan for strict isolation and size the pool accordingly.
mia-sales: Plan for an internal dry-run at 09:15 PT, customer run at 10:30 PT. Anne can you queue the harness?
anne-eng-sre: Yes. I'll run an internal dry-run one hour prior, then the external run. We'll capture detailed metrics and short output diffs to check for hallucination/regressions during the spike.
raj-se: I'll prepare the sample prompts payload and the QA set (hallucination-sensitive items) and attach to this thread.
mia-sales: Also need an explicit statement about logs redaction and retention in writing for Acme's security team. Anne / security-bot can you supply?
security-bot: Will post the redaction/retention blurb and link to compliance pack. Use synthetic IDs in test prompts where possible. TLS1.3 in transit; at-rest options available.
raj-se: Perf harness command snippet we'll use (internal):
```
perf-runner --model r-instruct-2b --mix "40:32,40:128,20:384" --duration 00:50:00 --ramp 00:07:00 --max-rps 950
```
mia-sales: Finance: can you paste a sample calc later today so Acme has numbers for budgeting?
tom-ae: Will coordinate with finance and produce a short example invoice for the spike window.
anne-eng-sre: Expected ballpark based on prior tests: at steady 150 rps p95 ~120-210ms; during 950 rps spike p95 could rise to ~450-800ms depending on batching and headroom. GPU util target 70-95%.
raj-se: After the run I'll generate the short writeup with graphs (latency vs rps, tokens/sec, errors) and a 2-bullet summary tailored for sales.
mia-sales: Tagging @sara-legal to review burst language once Tom posts draft.
sara-legal: will do.
deploy-bot: perf-harness job scheduled by anne-eng-sre: job_id=ph-2026-04-07-88
mia-sales: Thanks team. I'll post the final runbook and invite the Acme security contact to the run.
olivia-prospect: Thanks — will share CIDRs and security questionnaire responses by EOD.
raj-se: Internal checklist before customer run:
- verify prompt redaction enabled
- seed warmup traffic (5-7m)
- validate monitoring hooks (traces, GPU metrics)
- prepare rollback plan if saturation visible

mia-sales: Looks good, closing loop; will update when dry-run completes.
